name: Range Finder
tagline: Mobility that fixes your squat, press and hinge
about: Range Finder is mobility for people who lift: it screens your squat and overhead positions from a photo, finds the joint limiting a lift, and writes pre-lift warm-ups and 4-week range programmes for ankles, hips, thoracic spine and shoulders.
persona: You are a strength coach who takes mobility seriously: you test before you stretch, you load new range so it sticks, and you never prescribe 30 minutes of foam rolling.

onboarding.title: Which lift feels restricted?
onboarding.subtitle: Your lifts and sticky joints decide the screens and drills.
bullets: Load new range so it stays

tools.title: Screen a position
tools.subtitle: Photo at the bottom of a squat or overhead

inputs.label: Photo at the bottom of the squat or with arms overhead

tools.prompt: Screen the {position} in the photo. Sections: a table (Joint | What I see | Likely limiter: mobility, stability or technique | Test to confirm), steps for the confirming at-home test with a pass mark, bullets on what to change in the lift today, and a callout on when a restriction is a job for a clinician (pain, pinching, injury history).

tools.title: Fix a restriction
tools.subtitle: Depth, lockout, heels, butt wink…
tools.prompt: Solve '{problem}' for the profile lifts and sticky areas. Sections: bullets ranking the likely culprits (ankle, hip, thoracic, shoulder, technique), a table (Drill | Joint | Sets x reps or seconds | When to do it | Retest), steps for a 5-minute test, drill, retest sequence, and a callout on drills to skip if there is pinching or sharp pain.

tools.title: Pre-lift warm-up
tools.subtitle: Minutes tailored to today's lift
tools.prompt: Write a {minutes}-minute warm-up before {lift} for the profile sticky areas. Sections: steps in order (drill · reps or seconds · what it opens), a table (Drill | Target joint | Cue), a callout on how to know you are warm enough (a feeling, not a time), and bullets on empty-bar ramp sets after the warm-up.

tools.title: 4-week range programme
tools.subtitle: Daily minutes, one joint at a time
tools.prompt: Write a 4-week {joint} range programme at {minutes} minutes per day for the profile lifts. Sections: a table (Week | Daily drills | Sets x reps or holds | Loading progression), steps for the two key drills with form cues, a checklist of weekly retests with measurable targets (for example knee-to-wall cm), and a callout on loading new range in the lift so it sticks.

tools.title: Post-session reset
tools.subtitle: 5 minutes after lifting
tools.prompt: A 5-minute post-{lift} reset for the profile sticky areas. Sections: steps (drill · seconds · breathing), bullets on what to skip when very fatigued, and a quote with a single line on why long static stretching belongs in a separate session.

disclaimer: Not medical advice. Stop if you feel sharp pain, dizziness or chest symptoms, and check with a clinician before starting a new programme if you have a health condition or injury.
